sloka: तद्यथा नमुचिर्वृत्रो बलिर्नरकशम्बरौ ।त्वद्बलं समवष्टभ्य मया दग्धास्तथा कुरु ।। ७.२७.९ ॥
transliteration: tadyathā namucirvṛtro balirnarakaśambarau ।tvadbalaṁ samavaṣṭabhya mayā dagdhāstathā kuru ।। 7.27.9 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, just as Namuchi, Vritra, Bali, Naraka, and Shambara were destroyed by me with the support of your strength, so too act now.
